connector.name: Idf MCP
connector.registryDescription: Turn an IDF domain into an MCP server with invariants and role scopes in every tool description.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package mcp-server. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the intent-driven-software account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: IDF_SERVER
env.description: Base URL of the IDF host runtime (e.g. http://localhost:3001).

env.name: IDF_DOMAIN
env.description: IDF domain to expose as MCP tools (e.g. invest, booking, planning).

env.name: IDF_BOOTSTRAP
env.description: Set to 0 if the host runtime already bootstrapped the domain; 1 (default) to bootstrap from IDF_ONTOLOGY_PATH on first connection.

env.name: IDF_ONTOLOGY_PATH
env.description: Filesystem path to the domain ontology module (only used when IDF_BOOTSTRAP=1).

env.name: IDF_AUTH_TOKEN
env.description: Optional bearer token forwarded to the host runtime as the agent's role credential.
